Introduction

Huening Bahiyyih is a South Korean-American singer and dancer best known as a member of the South Korean project girl group Kep1er. She gained widespread recognition after participating in the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999 in 2021, where she finished in 2nd place, earning her spot in the final lineup of Kep1er.

Bahiyyih debuted as a member of Kep1er on January 3, 2022, with the release of their first mini-album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group's debut marked the beginning of Bahiyyih’s career in the kpop industry.
